entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: A nation of barbarians north of the Karplusan Mountains during the Ice Age on Terisiare.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation of Storgard refugees, enemy then ally of Balduvia.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who threatened eastern Terisiare with undead hordes.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The nation formed by Balduvians and Kjeldorans together.

entities.name: Malpiri
entities.description: Nation whose role the Balduvians overtook.

entities.name: Balduvian Steppes
entities.description: Land northwest of Kjeldor inhabited by Balduvians.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell that ended the Ice Age.

events.summary: Around 2500 AR Balduvia declares war on Kjeldor over ancestral lands, beginning a 400-year period of strife.
events.quote: Balduvia declared war on Kjeldor over their ancestral lands, starting a 400-year-long period of strife between the two nations

events.summary: Facing Lim-Dûl's undead hordes, the traditional enemies ally.
events.quote: the two traditional enemy lands allied to battle against his undead hordes

events.summary: After the World Spell and Thaw, Balduvia's lands become farmable; Balduvians and Kjeldorans form New Argive.
events.quote: Together they formed the nation of New Argive

relations.quote: Balduvia as the aggressors, and Kjeldor as the defenders

relations.note: allied against Lim-Dûl and later formed New Argive
relations.quote: further cemented their alliance with the Kjeldorans
the two traditional enemy lands allied to battle against his undead hordes
